limitations: Classic Verified contains historical public tasks: benchmark exposure and contamination remain possible.
Twelve tasks across six repository families are a feasibility panel, not sufficient evidence for a general routing advantage.
Discovery has two repetitions per candidate/task; validation and untouched holdout have one.
Unknown costs stop all new inference and retain their full request reservation; an unknown request is never retried.
Money limits and candidates are intentionally empty here: paid execution is authorized only through the coordinator's frozen campaign ledger, never from this file.
